data.data:
Dear Endministrator,

Arknights: Endfield PlayStation®5 Technical Test has officially ended. The server has been shut down, and you can no longer log in. All data from this test will be deleted. We sincerely thank all of you for following and participating in this test.


During the test, we received a lot of feedback through our official community, surveys, and customer support. We sincerely thank everyone for joining and sharing your thoughts. Our team will continue refining the game and optimizing the overall experience. New content is already in development, and we look forward to seeing you again in the official release!


For more updates, please follow our official community. Thank you again for your continued interest and support for Arknights: Endfield, Endministrator!
